zh: 我想请求图书馆延长借书的时间。
old_en: I want to ask the library for an extension on my book loan.
new_en: I want to ask the library for more time to keep the book.

zh: 我请求老板批准我的假期申请。
old_en: I asked my boss for approval of my vacation request.
new_en: I asked my boss to approve my vacation request.

zh: 我想请求老师多给我一点准备时间。
old_en: I want to ask my teacher for more preparation time.
new_en: I want to ask the teacher for more preparation time.

zh: 我请求朋友帮我复习数学。
old_en: I asked my friend for help with my math review.
new_en: I asked my friend to help me review math.
